notes.title: Starting Home in Our Farming Game - Get Kickstarter Launch Notification!
notes.notes:
Take a look at this sneak peek of the protagonist's initial house in our upcoming farming game! This city location serves as a nostalgic reminder of the protagonist's past life before they decided to pursue farming. In the game, players start from scratch with only a piece of land to build their own home and farm. The protagonist's journey will be about leaving their old life behind and starting anew, building a new home and a new life in the countryside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43985062/997493dec4c3f8729d5b36de6362bb02609bbf2d.gif[/img]

We're excited to announce that our Kickstarter campaign will be launching soon! Sign up at the link below to be notified when the campaign goes live:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/913374187/just-life]Kickstarter campaign[/url]

Thank you for your support and we hope you're as excited as we are to explore the world of our farming game!
